reviews.title: So good!
reviews.text: Absolutely love the workouts. I love how all the recipes are on the app as well. It has so many options of so many different workouts for what you want to target. I absolutely love the Pilates workouts. They really allowed me to get used to everything and I love how there’s always beginner oriented videos and no equipment videos. It makes following a lot easier.

reviews.title: Very confusing and overwhelming
reviews.text: For people that do not know what they are doing. This can be a deterrent. Having 200 choices is not necessarily a good thing when you are just trying to learn something. This may be good for seasoned gym goers but at that point why would you need the app.

reviews.title: Game changer
reviews.text: I’d been struggling to maintain a regular workout routine but finally told myself it was my #1 priority—to make working out an integral part of my life. I started with free YouTube MadFit videos. Once I proved to myself I was going to keep going, my reward was getting the app. I had been doing a lot of beginner workouts on YouTube so I decided to go with Phase 2 Strength to follow a workout plan. It’s challenging but I’m gradually getting stronger. The workouts aren’t super long, and I can do them right at home. Most use free weights. I’m really happy and grateful —I’m getting so much more than what I paid for. By this time next year, I’m going to be stronger than I’ve ever been in my life.

reviews.title: Deceitful and Unprofessional
reviews.text: This site is not only a complete waste of time but makes it impossible to cancel a subscription through the app itself. Upon being completely unsatisfied by the app, I attempted to cancel my subscription but found no button to do so. Instead, it said that my subscription would not be renewed at all. Then, they charged me and would not refund me for their faulty system. This app is deceitful and only cares about capitalizing on women’s insecurities by charging $30 for a “fitness plan.” Don’t waste your time or money on this.

reviews.title: The variety of workouts is amazing
reviews.text: I may be a tad bit biased because I was one of the instructors on the app, 😅, but seriously this app is the best I’ve seen in a LONG time. Ever, possibly. The fact that it’s a custom made app means that the user gets much more unique features that you actually USE! I also of course appreciate the quality of the workouts themselves. Maddie and the other instructors know what they are doing and it’s very obvious in my overall results and how often I come back to the app. The annual plan is very worth it!

reviews.title: App constantly crashes and gets rid of my stats
reviews.text: Also hasn’t given me any new workouts in August. Constantly logs me out and won’t air play to my TV

reviews.title: Excellent Fitness App
reviews.text: I have been following MadFit since 2020 during the pandemic. She has grown her business so much and has a wild amount of success because she is THAT good. I’m obsessed with this app. It’s so easy to navigate and has a very user friendly design. She has helped me build strength, maintain strength through 2 pregnancies and helped me lose my postpartum weight. I love Maddie, she truly is such an amazing trainer and is so easy to love. Download this app if you are looking to make working out apart of your daily life, you’ll be happy you did!

reviews.title: Let’s get to it!
reviews.text: I’ve been following Maddie’s workouts on YouTube for years, and I highly recommend upgrading to the app! her workouts are excellent, effective, and well designed to help you succeed, wherever you are on your fitness journey. Her encouragement is genuine and I always feel better after finishing one of her workouts!

reviews.title: Welcome Offer Won’t Work
reviews.text: I follow Maddie on YouTube and love her workouts. I’ve been using the free features on her app and think the full version would have been worthwhile. The 60% off welcome subscription would have been something I would have paid for (I feel it’s important to support people who put this much energy into something they believe in.) but I can’t justify $119 (regular subscription) a year on an app when I could get a whole planet fitness membership for $180. If they could make it so the 60% off welcome subscription works, I’d pay.

reviews.title: Love for at-home fitness
reviews.text: I’ve used MadFit for at least 5 years now, Maddy is an og but all the girls she’s added makes for great variety. Started this as a student when I couldn’t afford the price and time of a gym but never left since it’s so effective! High quality workouts at home are easy with the app and all the tracking tools help set and achieve goals as well!

reviews.title: Keeps me in shape
reviews.text: Best app ever and has kept me in consistency good shape the last few years! Love Madi and Helena’s work outs!

reviews.title: Love this app!!!
reviews.text: Madfit is a fantastic app that lets me access a huge variety of workouts in different formats from different instructors (all female) that all have their own unique style. It’s easy to navigate and filter through the workouts, or you can follow a program. I’ve been doing Maddie’s workouts for years and am so happy for this app!!

reviews.title: Great workouts and greater coaches!
reviews.text: Love MadFit! The different instructors and their styles are so very good!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I’ve been working out with Maddie since the pandemic and her workouts never disappoint. They’re fun, good length time wise and very effective. The app brings my workouts to another level with the incredible variety. There is a workout for every mood, moment and level of fitness. I recommend this app to EVERYONE!!

reviews.title: I LOVE ❤️ ⭐️
reviews.text: I absolutely love that on this app is like the only workout app or I don’t have to pay for anything like this is the only app that I do not have to pay for like everyone just it five stars

reviews.title: Loveee
reviews.text: Love this app so much, it has changed my life!! I noticed that there was not an option to search all workouts anymore, rather only by category. An option to search all but also by category would be super helpful!! Thanks Madi! xx

reviews.title: Good app wish there were more options
reviews.text: I really like the app, it is relatable, they give you many workout options and I appreciate the timer and primer for what exercise is next. I wish there was a way to build a more personalized workout plan in the app and balance some of the YouTube one off workouts. There are fully established plans to follow though and those are nice. Navigating to different sections of the app were not initially intuitive but play with the app and it will make sense.. overall I like it

reviews.title: Well rounded, not cheerleader style
reviews.text: I love Maddie and her Associates’ workouts. I’m 56 and in decent shape. Their personalities are very down to earth and relatable, numerous workouts to choose from, the filters make it easy to find the kind of workout you want to do each time.

reviews.title: The best workout app I’ve ever tried
reviews.text: MadFit has been the key for me finally staying consistent with working out. I greatly appreciate how much Maddie and all of the instructors on this app consistently give cues and tips for maintaining good form and connecting mind to muscle. They understand that part of the responsibility of virtual fitness instructors is to make sure their workouts and teaching style prioritizes safety and effectiveness for viewers with a wide range of experience levels. Only thing I would love is if there was a way for my progress in workout programs to be saved across multiple devices. At home I use my iPad and when I’m traveling or at the gym I use my phone and even though it’s the same account, the app doesn’t update across devices. But at the end of the day I will forever use this app and am so grateful it exists! I never thought I would be someone that not only lifts weights but actually looks forward to working out and I have MadFit to thank for this!

reviews.title: Love it!!
reviews.text: I’ve loved MadFit videos on YouTube and now I’ve had the app for almost a year and I’m just as obsessed! I do one or two a day a couple days a week. :) always can find one that fits my vibe.

reviews.title: Great Workout App
reviews.text: I was following along with videos on YouTube for a while and then made the decision to get this app. I really glad I did as there are so many more workouts and actual programs for me to follow to help me on my fitness journey!

reviews.title: Great Workouts!
reviews.text: Really accommodates any level you’re at whether you’re beginner, intermediate, or advanced they it have all included.

reviews.title: New to the App
reviews.text: New to the app but found Madfit on YouTube back in August at the beginning of my fitness journey. Started with upper body resistance bands and haven’t looked back. Thank you for uplifting videos that make me feel happy to be working out again.

reviews.title: app reset & lost all data from last year AGAIN
reviews.text: UPDATED review: On a random Wednesday, the app logged me out and reset all of my data. AGAIN. My subscription renews in September and the app reset again in February. This is my last straw with this app and I cannot believe that your engineers can’t figure out how to avoid this issue. I adore this app; Maddie’s workouts have helped me become consistent and stronger over the past year. A month before my subscription was supposed to auto-renew, the app logged me out and reset all of my data from the past year. None of the workouts I’ve saved, my logged workouts, and the achievements I’ve scored. Not sure if it’s Apple’s fault, but seems like faulty app design and software to log paying users out and reset all of their hard work. If I can’t get my data back from this unnecessary reset, I’ll be looking somewhere else to subscribe to.

reviews.title: love maddie but
reviews.text: they say the app is free and it is but you can hardly do anything without paying for the upgraded version

reviews.title: Great workout opportunities!
reviews.text: Very frustrating app, desperately needs to be updated. Can’t cast to my TV, and the iPad version won’t fill the complete screen. I wish the owners would invest in making this a more friendly, versatile user experience. Tech is waaaay ahead of what is offered here. Sad, because the workouts are great, but getting to them is very frustrating

reviews.title: Could not cast videos to tv
reviews.text: I gave the app access to my local network but still couldn’t cast workout programs to my tv.

reviews.title: Need this app compatible to an Ipad’s screen horizontally.
reviews.text: The app runs vertically to Ipad’s screen. Which does not cover the full screen. So hard to follow the exercise as it looks very small and compact.

reviews.title: No need to look any further ladies!
reviews.text: I have tried several apps for working out! This is the one ladies!!! No need to look any further. I’ve had this workout app for over two years and I live the varieties.

reviews.title: Best workout app
reviews.text: I’ve tried a few other workout apps (growing with Anna, Apple+, Mila) and this one is by far my favorite. If you’re like me and struggle with burnout over lifting heavy weights, or what to do in the gym then this is the app for you. The programs make it easy to show up each day. There’s tons of options available. If you need no equipment, they have it. If you want heavy dumbbell options, they have it. Also, Liney (one of the strength instructors) is amazing!! She is similar to Maddie where she walks you through form and is so encouraging. Maddie’s YouTube videos are great, but the format is nothing compared to what you get in the app.

reviews.title: Well rounded, great for all levels
reviews.text: I have been using the workouts (YouTube and now the app) for about 3 years now.  It is transforming my body and helping me be consistent.  I appreciate the instruction, the motivation, and being able to quickly find the workouts I enjoy.  Thank you for being accessible and down to earth!  Loving it!

reviews.title: Good but I wish I had more access
reviews.text: I understand y’all need money but the only function I have access to without paying is the workouts that were already free on YouTube. I’d like at least one workout program to be free if possible just because it’ll help me be more motivated. I don’t normally pay for apps and stuff because I’m not rich or anything but I suppose when I’m older I can eventually buy it, just not anytime soon. I still love the workouts and stuff I just want more access to things even if it’s something small

reviews.title: Must have app!
reviews.text: Love this app and all the trainers on it! I use it almost every day, there’s a class for any intensity level or type of movement you’re feeling. It’s transformed my fitness journey and I can’t imagine going without it now!

reviews.title: I LOVE MADFIT
reviews.text: there is no other community like the madfit community!! i absolutely love everything that Maddie stands for and everything she produces! i feel so supported and pushed by her and her fellow trainers on the app! absolutely in love with everything here on the app!!! just perfection!!!

reviews.title: Great Program but buggy app
reviews.text: I have been using this on my IPad and noticed that my workouts were not logging in.  I have had to uninstall and reinstall this twice to get it to log the workouts.  May seem like a small thing but it takes away from the user experience.  I also noticed that you can’t switch between devices like my iPhone and my iPad which is extremely silly.  I enjoy my workouts but not the app.

reviews.title: This is a Great App!!!!
reviews.text: Thanks to all trainers involved in this! This is a relaxing but intense  all around fitness system!!! Very much recommended!!!!

reviews.title: Expensive
reviews.text: I don't like that I had to answer all of those questions just to then pay. Like at least do a 7 day free trail or something instead I have to pay to count my sleep and count how much water I drink like bro. That is ridiculous.

reviews.title: Great Content, Awful App
reviews.text: Why can you not edit or delete custom programs?

reviews.title: Talks you through the workout
reviews.text: The way Maddy explains the workout, the positioning of your body and breathing across all levels of difficulty is unrivaled!

reviews.title: Tech issue
reviews.text:
I had this app a few years ago and I absolutely loved it! Life got busy and I canceled my subscription, fully intending to come back. Fast-forward to yesterday and today. I downloaded the app again, and I wanted to pay for a subscription (the save 60% option). Every time I try to do so, it says “Sorry… something went wrong during purchase. Please try again.” If I click on the save $50 option, it will let me continue. But… why have the 60% option if you won’t let me do it? 

Please fix this as I was very much looking forward to using it again.

reviews.title: Almost perfect
reviews.text: I love this app but I wish there was an audio option to only hear the instructor’s voice and not the background music. It would be nice if we could play our own music like on Spotify. But it doesn’t let me play the exercise video and play my Spotify at the same time even if I mute the video. The background music can be so repetitive and boring, having good music while working out is so important. It would be nice to just hear Maddie’s voice/her instructions with no music and the option to play music on our device. Also I wish there was a version that I could use on my laptop, so I’m not limited to only using it on my tiny phone screen. Otherwise, it is the best fitness app I have used and has really helped my consistency!

reviews.title: Amazing workouts
reviews.text: MadFit has helped me through my fitness journey and has inspired me to set goals for myself. I would recommend 100%

reviews.title: Great Workouts and Format
reviews.text:
I loved using the MadFit YouTube videos for years, but I am genuinely glad I upgraded to the app. There is a huge variety of workouts to choose from with multiple specialized trainers and it’s easy to search and navigate through the app. 

The ability to customize my own workout programs or follow a preset program is nice too. Honestly I would like to see more preset workouts available. Occasionally the app would crash a few times when I first got it but that problem seems to have resolved. All in all a great app.

reviews.title: Great workout app!
reviews.text: Love Maddie and all things MadFit. Finally got the app during their killer Black Friday sale. Really enjoying most of the features so far. Not terribly impressed by the recipes, but still worth it for the workouts!

reviews.title: Amazing app but……..
reviews.text: I really like this app, but something things shouldn’t have to have a subscription to be able to do because being able to track how much water i drink shouldn’t be locked because i don’t have a subscription like there is a million different workout apps that allow me to track my water and this isn’t just about the water it’s just stupid things you need a subscription for like being able to like a video thats just dumb

reviews.title: Two weeks after post MUA procedure feeling stronger with MadFit 💪🏾
reviews.text: Two weeks after MUA shoulder procedure I’m glad I chose to follow Madit’s shoulder exercises routines. I can already feel myself growing stronger, and the progress has been truly encouraging 💪🏾🙏🏾❤️

reviews.title: Can’t subscribe
reviews.text: I like the workouts I’ve done on YouTube so I downloaded the app. Every time I try to subscribe i get an error “Error. something went wrong with your purchase. Try again. “

reviews.title: Five stars worthy!!!
reviews.text: This app has been super helpful. Also I am using MadFit on YouTube for exercising.

reviews.title: Watch what subscription you want - no refunds
reviews.text: You’re not able to cancel or get a refund if the app doesn’t work for you. They’ve locked me in for $100 despite me only using it for a couple of weeks. I’ve never had an app do this.

reviews.title: Awesome!!!!!!!
reviews.text: I am a 12 year old girl but love your workouts Maddie I just love the slow and intense workouts soo much and I am building my six pack abs with the workouts! Thank you!
